translations.web: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.
translations.bsb: They are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.
translations.kjv: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat
translations.asv: And they shall take of the blood, and put it on the two side-posts and on the lintel, upon the houses wherein they shall eat it.
